jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>We're looking for a <strong>Product Designer</strong> to join <strong>Growth</strong> at Discord and help shape how people find Discord, get set up, and stay connected over time.</p> <p>Growth sits at the front door of our consumer org. We're responsible for how Discord shows up in the world — how new people discover us, how they land and get started, and how existing users stay close to the conversations and communities they care about. It's a broad, fast-moving surface area, and design plays a central role in making each of those moments feel unmistakably like Discord.</p> <p>This role spans the full breadth of what Growth owns:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Notifications</strong> — helping users stay connected to what they care about, even when they're away. We're making notifications more intelligent, trusted, and effective: reaching people at the right moments, coordinating delivery thoughtfully, and giving users real control over their experience.</li> <li><strong>Off-platform</strong> — how Discord shows up beyond the app itself, across embeds, links, invites, web pages, and text messages.
